# HandSpark

> Local hand gesture reactions for Linux webcams. MIT licensed and usable by humans and AI agents.

- Repository: https://github.com/jeffreyrijnsburger/handspark
- Latest release: https://github.com/jeffreyrijnsburger/handspark/releases/latest
- Readme: README.md
- Agent instructions: AGENTS.md
- CLI contract: docs/CLI.md
- Build and release: docs/BUILDING.md
- Version: VERSION
- Changes: CHANGELOG.md
- License: LICENSE

Run `handspark commands --json` to discover the local automation interface.
Run `handspark status --json` for state without webcam images.
Reaction IDs: heart, balloons, thumbs_up, thumbs_down, rain, confetti, fireworks, lasers.
Supported platform: Ubuntu 24.04 amd64/X11; no Windows or macOS backend yet.
Language defaults to Dutch; English is configurable. Preserve the user's choice.
No cloud inference, account, telemetry or API key is needed at runtime.
